# MapleSpike — Canadian Public-Sector Data API
> Coverage, response fields, and publisher terms vary by endpoint and source.

> MCP server: https://mcp.maplespike.ca/sse (189 tools)
> MCP server card: https://quill.maplespike.ca/.well-known/mcp/server-cards.json
> Agent card: https://quill.maplespike.ca/agent-card.json · Agents index: https://quill.maplespike.ca/agents.json

## API
Base URL: https://api.maplespike.ca/v1
Auth: Authorization: Bearer header or X-API-Key header
Response: { success, data, quality, citation, meta }; payload and citation fields vary by endpoint.
Record hashes check canonical Quill record integrity only; source terms vary by publisher and dataset. Consult the original source before reuse.

### Endpoints
- GET /v1/health — API health check with usage stats
- GET /v1/openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.1 specification
- GET /v1/me — Current tenant info and API keys
- GET /v1/usage — Current billing period usage
- GET /v1/gov/releases — Latest government data releases
- GET /v1/gov/search — Full-text search across supported sources
- GET /v1/citation/:hash — Look up a record by hash; a match checks record integrity, not source authenticity
- GET /v1/claims/verify/:hash — Look up a claim hash and recorded provenance evidence when available (public)
- GET /v1/claims/latest — List recent claim summaries; source retrieval time may be unavailable (public)
- POST /v1/claims/verify — Recompute SHA-256 of canonical JSON for supplied data (public)
- POST /v1/register — Create account and API key
- GET /v1/verify/:token — Verify email address
- POST /v1/ai/ask — Ask a question and receive an AI-generated response
- POST /v1/ai/search — Semantic search with edge embeddings
- GET /v1/ai/models — List available AI models
- POST /v1/ai/analyze — Analyze text for bias, sentiment, or claims
- POST /v1/auth/refresh — Refresh JWT token
- POST /v1/auth/logout — Clear session
- POST /v1/billing/checkout — Create checkout session
- GET /v1/billing/plans — Available pricing plans
- GET /v1/keys — List API keys
- POST /v1/keys — Create API key
- DELETE /v1/keys/:id — Delete API key
- POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate — Rotate API key
- GET /v1/signals — Cross-reference signals (requires engine)
- GET /v1/extraction/tasks — List browser extraction tasks for portals without APIs
- POST /v1/extraction/results — Submit extracted data from browser client
- GET /v1/extraction/cached/:source_id — Get cached browser extraction results
- GET /v1/data/quality — Module health, freshness, and error tracking

### Data Categories
- committees — Available House of Commons and Senate committee records, where supported
- lobbying — Selected federal and provincial lobbying registry records
- procurement — Selected CanadaBuys contract awards and tenders
- gazette — Available Canada Gazette Parts I, II, and III records
- elections — Selected third-party advertiser, election, and political-donation records
- oversight — Selected records from oversight bodies, where supported
- courts — Selected federal court decisions via CanLII, where supported
- influence — Selected records about international organizations, NGOs, and think tanks
- immigration — Selected IRCC, LMIA, Express Entry, study, and work-permit data
- defence — Selected DND personnel and defence-procurement records
- health — Selected Health Canada datasets and product records
- transport — Selected Transport Canada, infrastructure, and GTFS transit data
- indigenous — Selected Indigenous services, statistics, and First Nations records
- provincial — Selected provincial and territorial sources
- municipal — Selected municipal open-data sources
- economic — Selected economic indicators from StatCan and the Bank of Canada
- international — Selected data from international statistical sources
- environment — Selected environmental, climate, fisheries, and parks sources
- corporate — Selected corporate filings, insider-trading, and registry records
- housing — Selected CMHC and municipal housing records
- extraction — Some browser-extracted data from portals without APIs
